configurePresets.name: c-legacy
configurePresets.description: ENABLE_CPP_UPGRADES=OFF. Builds mg exactly like upstream with the system Apple Clang. No C++ / modules involved.

configurePresets.name: cpp
configurePresets.description: ENABLE_CPP_UPGRADES=ON. Drives BOTH C and C++ with MacPorts clang-21 so the extern "C" bridge links one consistent toolchain, and points CMake at the (suffix-free) clang-scan-deps it needs for C++20 module scanning.

configurePresets.name: cpp-tsan
configurePresets.description: Same toolchain as cpp, with ENABLE_TSAN=ON to gate the FM-ASYNC-STATUS monitor thread (snapshot/modeline races) and any other concurrency. ENABLE_ZIG_STATUS is forced OFF here: the Zig worktree walker is not TSan-instrumented (built by `zig build`, not -fsanitize=thread), so TSan can't see its internal thread joins and reports false 'data race in free' on its post-join allocations -- the same uninstrumented-dependency problem libgit2 has (tsan.supp). The hybrid path's correctness is covered by the non-TSan cpp/cpp-linux builds. The CMakeLists ENABLE_TSAN block instruments every target and, on macOS, links the clang-21 instrumentation against Apple's OS-matched runtime (path derived from xcrun) because the MacPorts runtime crashes at startup on macOS 26.5.

configurePresets.name: cpp-kqueue
configurePresets.displayName: C++23 + modules, kqueue fswatch backend (BSD proxy)
configurePresets.description: Same as cpp but MG_FSWATCH_FORCE_KQUEUE=ON, so mg.fswatch compiles the kqueue backend instead of FSEvents. macOS shares the BSD EVFILT_VNODE kqueue API, so running the fswatch suite here exercises the FreeBSD/OpenBSD/NetBSD code path without a BSD machine. ENABLE_ZIG_STATUS=OFF keeps it focused on the watcher (no zig toolchain needed).

configurePresets.name: cpp-linux
configurePresets.description: Native Linux build (Arch primary, Alpine too). Uses the distro clang/clang++ in PATH; CMake auto-detects clang-scan-deps next to it. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 lets the fetched doctest configure under CMake 4.x. Used by the docker/ images and for native builds: `cmake --preset cpp-linux && cmake --build --preset cpp-linux && ctest --preset cpp-linux`.

configurePresets.name: cpp-linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: cpp-linux with ENABLE_TSAN=ON. On Linux the toolchain's own TSan runtime works directly -- no Apple-runtime rpath dance needed (that path is macOS-only in the CMakeLists ENABLE_TSAN block). ENABLE_ZIG_STATUS is forced OFF here: the uninstrumented Zig walker's internal threads produce TSan false positives ('data race in free') that TSan cannot resolve without seeing the Zig-side joins -- same as the libgit2 suppression. The hybrid path is correctness-checked by the non-TSan arch/alpine builds.
